From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 23:02:00 +0000
Subject: Recap + action items from call — estimate & ops checklist

Hi Jordan — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side (keeping short):

- Goal we heard: proof positive reduction in per-token inference cost for your chat assistant without degrading quality, and predictable latency under 200ms P95 for 95% of traffic.
- What we shared: preliminary estimate for a dedicated pool and a hosted failover path (attached), and the pricing deck with optioned configurations.
- Immediate asks for scoping: a) confirmation that latency SLO above is the right target, b) expected monthly token volume (ballpark is fine), c) any compliance constraints (retention, KMS).

Attachments: Redwood_Estimate_Q2_2027.pdf (PDF, 2 pages) — detailed cost model; Redwood_Pricing_Deck_v3.pptx (PPTX, 12 slides)

Proposed next step: 20-minute walkthrough with me + Dev to step through the estimate and call out configuration choices. Two short slots I have next week: Tue 2027-04-20 16:00–16:20 PT or Wed 2027-04-21 10:00–10:20 PT. If neither works, share a couple of windows that do.

If this isn't a priority right now, a quick note will help us pause follow-ups.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 19:05:00 +0000
Subject: RE: quick nudge — estimate + 20m walkthrough?

Aisha / Dev —

I skimmed the estimate this afternoon. A couple of quick thoughts before we push again:

- Offer an ops-day slot: recommend proposing a short call that includes their infra/ops lead (to handle KMS, VPC peering questions) — that tends to unblock procurement faster.
- Consider a limited pilot pricing option (4–6 week pilot with a lower committed rate) rather than immediate annual commit. We can flag this as "pilot pricing" in the deck; it usually shortens decision cycles.
- If they don't reply to the second nudge, try a one-line from an executive (e.g., 15% discount approval) — only if we need to escalate.

I can join the walkthrough if you want an ops/technical-forward face.

Marissa
Enterprise AE Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

We're interested and I want to loop in Priya (head of ML infra) to validate latency/SLO expectations and KMS setup. Two windows that would work for us:

- Tue 2027-04-20 16:00–16:20 PT (your suggestion)
- Thu 2027-04-22 14:00–14:20 PT

Thanks,
